rules.rationale: Expands the vowelCodes macro to the fixed IntSeq encoding of the ten lowercase and uppercase vowel characters.
Defines the total isVowelCode predicate by an explicit disjunction of the ten vowel character codes.

Specializes the reference semantics' existing strContains function for a one-character needle and vowelCodes; it is an additional equivalence compiled into the proof definition before kprove and is not separately proved without the rule.
Defines the empty-input base case of the accumulator-style removeVowelCodesAcc mathematical summary.
Defines the recursive removeVowelCodesAcc case that skips a head character satisfying isVowelCode.
Defines the recursive removeVowelCodesAcc case that appends a non-vowel head character to the accumulator.
Defines removeVowelCodes as removeVowelCodesAcc initialized with the empty accumulator.
Expands the removeVowelsLoopBody macro to the exact Python-AST statement sequence used as the loop body.
Expands the removeVowelsBody macro to the function's initialization, loop, and return statement sequence.
Expands removeVowelsProgram to the module AST containing the remove_vowels function definition.
